verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API reference page exists (docs.trychannel3.com/api-reference/v1/search.md documents request parameters). Nothing shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. A static reference alone is an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable experience the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
